test_cases.scenario: Add a product to the wishlist with the heart icon
test_cases.expected_result: The heart icon becomes filled and the wishlist page lists 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: Remove a product by clicking the filled heart
test_cases.expected_result: The heart icon becomes empty and 'Blue Mug' is no longer on the wishlist page

test_cases.scenario: Add the 50th product to a wishlist holding 49
test_cases.expected_result: The product is added and the wishlist page lists 50 products; no 'full' message is shown

test_cases.scenario: Adding a 51st product is rejected
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Your wishlist is full (50 items)' is shown, the heart stays empty and the wishlist still lists exactly 50 products

test_cases.scenario: Guest clicking the heart is redirected to login
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product page as a guest
test_cases.expected_result: The browser navigates to the login page and the product is not added to any wishlist yet

test_cases.scenario: After logging in from the heart redirect, the product is added
preconditions: User is a guest who clicked the heart on 'Blue Mug' and is on the login page
Account asha@example.com has an empty wishlist
steps: Log in with the credentials from test data
test_cases.expected_result: The wishlist of asha@example.com contains 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: Wishlist page shows the current price after a price change
preconditions: 'Blue Mug' was added to the wishlist at ₹500
The price of 'Blue Mug' was then changed to ₹450
test_cases.expected_result: 'Blue Mug' is listed with price ₹450 (not ₹500) and its stock status

test_cases.scenario: Wishlist page shows stock status for an out-of-stock product
preconditions: 'Red Lamp' is in the wishlist and its stock is 0
test_cases.expected_result: 'Red Lamp' is listed with an out-of-stock status and its current price

test_cases.scenario: Move a wishlist item to the cart
preconditions: 'Blue Mug' (in stock) is in the wishlist
steps: Use the move-to-cart action on 'Blue Mug'
test_cases.expected_result: The cart contains 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: Eligible customer submits a review with rating and text
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
test_cases.expected_result: The review is saved and shown on the product page with 5 stars and the entered text

test_cases.scenario: Customer without an order of the product cannot review it
preconditions: Customer ravi@example.com is logged in and has never ordered 'Blue Mug'
steps: Try to open the review form and submit a 4-star review
test_cases.expected_result: No review from ravi@example.com is saved: the review form is unavailable or submission is refused, and the review count is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Order not yet delivered does not allow a review
preconditions: Customer meera@example.com is logged in and her only order with 'Blue Mug' has status SHIPPED
steps: Try to open the review form and submit a 4-star review
test_cases.expected_result: No review from meera@example.com is saved and the review count is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Guest cannot submit a review
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product page as a guest
test_cases.expected_result: No review is saved and the review count is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Review without a star rating is rejected
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
steps: Open the review form for 'Blue Mug'
test_cases.expected_result: The review is not saved and the rating is indicated as required; the review count is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Rating-only review with 1 star (minimum) is accepted
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
steps: Open the review form for 'Blue Mug'
Select 1 star and leave the text empty
test_cases.expected_result: The review is saved and shown with 1 star and no text

test_cases.scenario: Review text of exactly 1000 characters is accepted
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
steps: Open the review form for 'Blue Mug'
Select 4 stars and paste a 1000-character text
test_cases.expected_result: The review is saved and the displayed text contains all 1000 characters

test_cases.scenario: Review text of 1001 characters is not saved in full
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
steps: Open the review form for 'Blue Mug'
Select 4 stars and paste a 1001-character text
test_cases.expected_result: No review with more than 1000 characters is stored: the field stops at 1000 characters or submission is refused with an error

test_cases.scenario: Second review for the same product is not allowed
preconditions: Customer asha@example.com is logged in and has a DELIVERED order containing 'Blue Mug'
asha already has a 5-star review on 'Blue Mug'
steps: Try to submit a new 3-star review
test_cases.expected_result: No second review is created; asha still has exactly one review on 'Blue Mug' and the total count is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Editing a review updates it and the average
preconditions: 'Blue Mug' has exactly 3 reviews rated 4, 4 and 5; the 5-star review belongs to logged-in customer asha
steps: Edit the rating from 5 to 2 and save
test_cases.expected_result: asha's review shows 2 stars, the review count is still 3, and the average shows 3.3

test_cases.scenario: Average rating is rounded to one decimal place with total count
preconditions: 'Blue Mug' has exactly 3 reviews rated 4, 4 and 5
test_cases.expected_result: The product page shows average rating 4.3 and a total of 3 reviews

test_cases.scenario: Percentage coupon is applied to the subtotal before shipping
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
Coupon SAVE10 (10% off, min subtotal ₹500, not expired) exists
test_cases.expected_result: Discount ₹100 is applied, subtotal becomes ₹900, shipping stays ₹50 and the order total is ₹950

test_cases.scenario: Fixed-amount coupon is applied to the subtotal
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
Coupon FLAT200 (₹200 off, min subtotal ₹500, not expired) exists
test_cases.expected_result: Discount ₹200 is applied, subtotal becomes ₹800 and the order total is ₹850

test_cases.scenario: Coupon code is accepted in lowercase
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: SAVE10 is applied and the subtotal becomes ₹900

test_cases.scenario: Only one coupon can be applied to an order
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: The order summary shows exactly one coupon discount (either SAVE10 or FLAT200, never both combined)

test_cases.scenario: Expired coupon is rejected
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'This coupon has expired' is shown and the subtotal stays ₹1000

test_cases.scenario: Coupon expiring tomorrow is still accepted
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: SOON10 is applied and the subtotal becomes ₹900

test_cases.scenario: Subtotal ₹1 below the coupon minimum is rejected
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'Add ₹1 more to use this coupon' is shown and the subtotal stays ₹499

test_cases.scenario: Subtotal exactly at the coupon minimum is accepted
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: SAVE10 is applied and the subtotal becomes ₹450

test_cases.scenario: Fixed discount larger than the subtotal does not make it negative
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
Coupon FLAT300 (₹300 off, no minimum above ₹200, not expired) exists
test_cases.expected_result: The subtotal after discount is not negative (≥ ₹0) and the order total is never below the shipping amount

test_cases.scenario: Fixed discount equal to the subtotal brings it to exactly zero
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
Coupon FLAT200 (₹200 off, min subtotal ≤ ₹200) exists
test_cases.expected_result: The subtotal after discount is ₹0 and only shipping remains in the total

test_cases.scenario: Unknown coupon code is not applied
preconditions: Customer is logged in and at checkout
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon is rejected with an error message and the subtotal stays ₹1000

coverage_summary.notes: All 12 functional requirements across Wishlist, Reviews and Coupons are covered, including boundaries at 50/51 wishlist items, 1000/1001 review characters, the coupon minimum subtotal and discounts at or above the subtotal. The non-functional 'load quickly' statement is reported as a gap because it has no target. Open questions Q-2..Q-4 leave expiry-day, move-to-cart and empty-review behaviour untested.

requirements.text: Customer adds a product to the wishlist with the heart icon; clicking the filled heart removes it
Wishlist holds at most 50 products; adding a 51st shows 'Your wishlist is full (50 items)'
Guest clicking the heart is redirected to login and the product is added after logging in
Wishlist page lists products with current price and stock status and lets the customer move an item to the cart
Only customers with a delivered order containing the product can review it
A review has a required 1-5 star rating and optional text up to 1000 characters
One review per customer per product; it can be edited afterwards
Product page shows the average rating rounded to one decimal and the total number of reviews
Customer can enter one coupon code at checkout; codes are case-insensitive
A valid coupon applies its percentage or fixed discount to the subtotal before shipping
Coupons have an expiry date and a minimum subtotal with messages 'This coupon has expired' / 'Add ₹<amount> more to use this coupon'
The discount can never make the order subtotal negative
